spec.situation_desc: had a loan application declined with no explanation

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, you’re through to Zara at Thistle Bank. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi. I’m Amira Quigley. My loan application was declined, and nobody’s told me why. I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you’ve been left without an explanation, Amira. I’ll look into what I can. Before we discuss your application, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Amira Quigley, and it’s the 14th of June 1989.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. I understand why you’re frustrated. I’m logging this as a complaint about the declined loan application and the lack of explanation.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Good. I just want someone to tell me what’s happened.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll take ownership of making sure your complaint is recorded properly. I can’t promise what the outcome will be, but I’ll make sure the concerns you’ve raised are included.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll submit the complaint today and send you a written acknowledgement within five working days. Our complaints team will review it, and you’ll receive a full written response within eight weeks.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Will that response explain the decision?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: The team will address your complaint about the decision and the lack of explanation. I’ll check that your application details are attached to the complaint before I submit it today.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to summarise: I’m logging this as a complaint today, I’ll check the application details are included before submitting it, and the complaints team will send you a full written response within eight weeks. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, Amira. I’m sorry again that you had to chase for an explanation, and I appreciate you speaking with me today.
